name: de.wattklarheit/finanz-seo-x402
title: Finanz & SEO Tools API
description: Paid x402 API: finance, euro rates, crypto, German/EU tax, SEO, weather and web tools.

tools.name: de_crypto_tax_holding_period
tools.description: German crypto tax check (§23 EStG): is a crypto sale tax-free after the 1-year holding period, first tax-free date, and 1,000 EUR Freigrenze check incl. other private sale gains. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: de_crypto_tax_fifo
tools.description: FIFO capital gains for crypto per German BMF letter (10.05.2022): splits each sale into tax-free (>1 year) and taxable parts, yearly totals with 1,000 EUR Freigrenze, remaining lots with tax-free dates. Up to 2,000 transactions. Price: $0.02 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: de_kleinunternehmer
tools.description: German small-business VAT exemption check (§19 UStG, thresholds since 2025: 25,000 EUR prior year / 100,000 EUR current year), headroom and invoice note. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: de_capital_gains_tax
tools.description: German capital gains tax (Abgeltungsteuer 25% + Soli + optional church tax 8/9%), Sparerpauschbetrag (1,000/2,000 EUR) and fund Teilfreistellung (equity 30%, mixed 15%, real estate 60/80%). Returns net gain and effective rate. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: fin_savings_plan
tools.description: Savings plan / compound interest projection with monthly contributions, yearly increase (Dynamik), fund costs (TER), inflation-adjusted value, yearly table and German tax estimate on sale. Price: $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: seo_audit
tools.description: Automated on-page SEO audit of any public URL: title/meta description length, headings, canonical, noindex/robots, robots.txt and sitemap.xml, image alt coverage, internal/external links, Open Graph/Twitter cards, JSON-LD structured data, response time, page size, word count, score 0-100 and a prioritized fix list. Price: $0.10 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: web_read
tools.description: Read any public web page and get clean main content as Markdown (or text/html) plus title, author, publish date, language, Open Graph metadata and link stats. Boilerplate (nav, ads, footers) removed. HTML and plain text, max 3 MB source. Price: $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: web_domain_intel
tools.description: Domain intelligence in one call: DNS (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA, SOA), email security (SPF, DMARC policy, MTA-STS), RDAP registration (registrar, created, expires, age), TLS certificate (issuer, expiry, days left), HTTPS redirect and security headers, plus prioritized findings. Price: $0.004 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: x402_recommend
tools.description: Find the right paid x402 API for a task: describe what you need and get ranked endpoints with price, networks, method, 30-day calls and unique payers. Ranking combines text relevance with real recent paid usage; unused, single-payer and wallet-farming listings are filtered out. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: crypto_wallet_balances
tools.description: Multi-chain EVM wallet snapshot: native coin plus USDC/USDT/WETH/EURC balances on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Scroll, Linea, zkSync, Unichain and Gnosis with USD values from Chainlink price feeds. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: crypto_token_scan
tools.description: ERC-20 token risk scan from on-chain data (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum): name/symbol/supply, owner and renounce status, upgradeable proxy detection, privileged functions in bytecode (mint, blacklist, pause, fee change, trading switch), Uniswap v2/v3 liquidity vs WETH/USDC, risk score and flags. Price: $0.008 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: fx_ecb
tools.description: Official ECB euro reference exchange rates (about 30 currencies), latest or for any date since 1999, any base currency via EUR cross rates, with amount conversion. Weekends/holidays fall back to the previous fixing. Price: $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: de_holidays
tools.description: German public holidays for any year 1995-2100, nationwide or per federal state (BW, BY, BE, BB, HB, HH, HE, MV, NI, NW, RP, SL, SN, ST, SH, TH), with weekday and which states observe each day. Price: $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: de_business_days
tools.description: German business-day math per federal state: count working days between two dates, or add/subtract N working days to compute deadlines (weekends and state holidays excluded). Price: $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: web_extract
tools.description: Extract structured data from any public web page: HTML tables as JSON (headers, rows, captions), JSON-LD / schema.org objects, and definition lists. No LLM. Useful mid-task when an agent needs tabular or typed data rather than prose. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: eu_einvoice
tools.description: Extract structured JSON from a European e-invoice: XRechnung, ZUGFeRD / Factur-X (PDF with embedded, compressed XML), UBL 2.1 and UN/CEFACT CII. Returns seller/buyer (name, address, VAT ID, contact), buyer reference / Leitweg-ID, order reference, issue/due/delivery dates, payment terms, IBAN/BIC, payment reference, line items, VAT breakdown and totals. Send JSON {xml}|{base64}|{url} or the raw XML/PDF as request body (application/xml or application/pdf, max 3.5 MB). Price: $0.008 USDC per call via x402.

url.description: public http(s) URL of the XML or PDF

tools.name: de_impressum
tools.description: Extract the legally required German Impressum (legal notice, § 5 DDG) from a public website: operator, address, email, phone, VAT ID, Handelsregister (court + HRB/HRA), and the person responsible under § 18 MStV. Follows an /impressum link on the same host when the start page is not the notice itself. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: de_law
tools.description: Look up a German federal statute from the official gesetze-im-internet.de publication (Federal Ministry of Justice / Federal Office of Justice). Pass a well-known abbreviation (EStG, UStG, BGB, HGB, AO, GG, DDG, …) or the law title; optional paragraph or article returns the official section text with a link to the official page. Without a paragraph, returns the table of contents. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

article.description: article number for laws such as GG

tools.name: eu_id_check
tools.description: Check an EU/German identifier in one call: EU VAT ID via the official VIES API (name/address when published), EORI via the official Commission EOS service, IBAN ISO 13616 checksum, German tax ID (IdNr) checksum, and LEI via the official GLEIF API. Auto-detects the type, or set type=vat|eori|iban|idnr|lei. A VAT-shaped value is checked against both VIES and EORI. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: eu_vat_check
tools.description: Live EU VAT ID (USt-IdNr.) validation against the official European Commission VIES service: valid/invalid, registered name and address (where the member state publishes them), request date, optional consultation number (pass requesterVat) and approximate trader-name/address matching. Per-country format pre-check. If VIES or the member-state database is down the call returns HTTP 503 with status vies_unavailable and the payment is NOT settled. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

vat.description: Full VAT ID with country prefix, e.g. DE811569869, IE6388047V, ATU12345678 (GR is mapped to EL). Spaces/dots ignored.

countryCode.description: Alternative to vat: 2-letter VIES country code (EL for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland)

vatNumber.description: Alternative to vat: number without country prefix

requesterVat.description: Optional: your own EU VAT ID to receive an official consultation number (qualified confirmation)

traderName.description: Optional: name to approximately match (supported by some member states)

traderPostalCode.description: Optional: postal code to approximately match

tools.name: eu_iban_check
tools.description: IBAN validation (ISO 13616 MOD-97 checksum, country length and format for 80+ countries), print format, bank code, SEPA country flag. For German IBANs: bank name, BIC, city and check-digit method from the official Deutsche Bundesbank Bankleitzahlendatei (flags unknown or deleted BLZ). Optional bic parameter is cross-checked against the bank directory. Offline and fast. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

bic.description: Optional BIC/SWIFT to cross-check (8 or 11 chars)

tools.name: compliance_sanctions
tools.description: Sanctions screening: fuzzy name match of a person or company against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (European Commission FSF) and the UN Security Council Consolidated List (all names and aliases, diacritics/transliteration/legal-form tolerant, Jaro-Winkler). Returns top matches with score, list, reference number, entity type, programmes, birth dates, citizenships, UN listing date / EU regulation date, optional birth-year/country consistency flags, and each list's publication date. Screening aid, not legal advice. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

name.description: Person or organisation name to screen (3-200 chars)

type.description: Restrict to persons or entities (default any)

lists.description: Comma list of eu, un (default eu,un)

birthYear.description: Optional birth year of the screened person; adds dobMatch (+/-1 year) and ranks contradicting hits last

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 nationality; adds countryMatch

tools.name: eu_einvoice_validate
tools.description: Validate a German/EU e-invoice (E-Rechnung) with the OFFICIAL rule sets: CEN EN 16931 schematron (UBL + CII, validation-1.3.17) and KoSIT XRechnung 3.0 CIUS schematron. Accepts XRechnung UBL/CII XML or a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (embedded XML is extracted). Checks well-formedness, detects syntax and profile (XRechnung, Factur-X MINIMUM/BASIC WL/BASIC/EN16931/EXTENDED, Peppol BIS), returns valid/invalid with every error and warning (rule ID such as BR-CO-16 or BR-DE-15, message, XPath location) plus a short invoice summary. Send JSON {xml}|{base64}|{url} or the raw XML/PDF body (application/xml, application/pdf; max 3.5 MB). Optional rules=auto|en16931|xrechnung. Price: $0.02 USDC per call via x402.

xml.description: XRechnung / EN 16931 invoice XML (UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII)

base64.description: base64 of the XML or of a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF

url.description: public http(s) URL of the XML or PDF

rules.description: auto (default): XRechnung rules for XRechnung documents, EN 16931 for others

tools.name: eu_einvoice_generate
tools.description: Generate a valid XRechnung 3.0 (or plain EN 16931 / Factur-X EN16931 XML) e-invoice from a simple JSON payload, as UN/CEFACT CII or UBL 2.1 (invoice, credit note 381, partial/corrected invoices). Computes line totals, VAT breakdown per category/rate (S, Z, E incl. § 19 UStG Kleinunternehmer, AE reverse charge, K, G, O) and totals, then self-validates with the official CEN EN 16931 + KoSIT XRechnung schematron. Returns the XML plus validation report. If the result violates a business rule the call returns HTTP 422 with the rule errors and is NOT charged. Price: $0.03 USDC per call via x402.

syntax.description: Output syntax (default cii; ZUGFeRD/Factur-X use CII)

profile.description: xrechnung (default, XRechnung 3.0 CIUS) or en16931 (plain EN 16931, e.g. for a Factur-X/ZUGFeRD EN16931 PDF)

typeCode.description: 380 invoice (default), 381 credit note, 384 corrected, 326 partial, 389 self-billed

buyerReference.description: BT-10, Leitweg-ID for German public buyers (required by XRechnung)

vatExemptionReason.description: for categories E/AE/K/G/O, e.g. 'Kein Ausweis von Umsatzsteuer, da Kleinunternehmer gemäß § 19 UStG'

seller.description: name, street, postalCode, city, country, vatId and/or taxNumber, registrationId (e.g. HRB), id, email, phone, contactName, electronicAddress (+scheme; defaults to email/EM)

buyer.description: name, street, postalCode, city, country, vatId, id, email or electronicAddress (required by XRechnung)

payment.description: meansCode (58 SEPA transfer default with iban, 30, 59, 10...), iban, bic, accountName, reference

unitCode.description: UN/ECE Rec 20, e.g. C62 piece (default), HUR hour, DAY, KGM, LS lump sum

tools.name: eu_einvoice_from_scan
tools.description: Invoice OCR: turn a scanned or photographed invoice (JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF) or a non-structured PDF (text layer or embedded scan images, max 3 pages, 4 MB) into structured JSON with per-field confidence: invoice number, dates, seller/buyer name and address, VAT ID, tax number, HRB, IBAN (checksum-validated, bank/BIC from the Bundesbank directory), BIC, payment terms and due date, net/VAT/gross totals, VAT breakdown, § 19 / reverse-charge hints and line items. Cross-checks the arithmetic (line sum = net, basis × rate = VAT, net + VAT = gross) and flags inconsistencies. Nothing is guessed: unreadable fields are null with confidence 0. Optional xrechnung=cii|ubl builds an XRechnung 3.0 / EN 16931 XML via the official schematron and returns validation errors or the list of missing business terms instead of inventing data. German and English invoices. Send the file as raw body (Content-Type image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/tiff or application/pdf) or JSON {base64} / {url}. No charge (HTTP 4xx/422) if no text can be read. Price: $0.04 USDC per call via x402.

base64.description: base64 of a JPEG/PNG/WebP/TIFF image or PDF (alternatively POST the raw file with its Content-Type)

url.description: public http(s) URL of the image or PDF

xrechnung.description: also generate and validate an XRechnung/EN 16931 XML from the extracted data (query parameter when posting a raw file)

profile.description: profile for the generated XML (default xrechnung)

buyerEmail.description: buyer electronic address (BT-49), usually not printed on the invoice

leitwegId.description: buyer reference / Leitweg-ID (BT-10) if not printed

tools.name: de_late_payment_interest
tools.description: German statutory default interest (Verzugszinsen, § 288 BGB): base rate (Basiszinssatz § 247 BGB, live from Deutsche Bundesbank with full history since 2002) + 5 points (consumer involved) or + 9 points (B2B), split into periods at every base-rate change and year end, actual/365, plus the 40 EUR B2B lump sum (§ 288 Abs. 5 BGB) and the total claim. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

b2b.description: true if no consumer is involved (base rate + 9 points and 40 EUR lump sum); default false (+5 points)

margin.description: override the points above base rate (e.g. contractual)

tools.name: de_real_estate_transfer_tax
tools.description: German real-estate transfer tax (Grunderwerbsteuer) for a purchase price in any of the 16 states, with the rate valid on the acquisition date (rate history since 2016, e.g. Bremen 5.5 % from 01.07.2025), rounding down to full euros, the 2,500 EUR exemption and a comparison of all states. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

state.description: state code (BW, BY, BE, BB, HB, HH, HE, MV, NI, NW, RP, SL, SN, ST, SH, TH) or name; omit to compare all

tools.name: de_gross_net
tools.description: German gross-to-net salary 2026 (Brutto-Netto): wage tax, solidarity surcharge and church-tax base computed with the official BMF Programmablaufplan 2026 (verified against 29 BMF reference cases), church tax 8/9 %, and employee social insurance with the 2026 values (health incl. additional contribution, care with childless surcharge/child discounts/Saxony, pension, unemployment, assessment ceilings, Übergangsbereich 603.01-2,000 EUR). Tax classes 1-6, factor method, monthly or yearly. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

gross.description: gross salary in EUR for the period

state.description: state code/name (church-tax rate 8 % BY/BW else 9 %; Saxony care rate), default NW

childAllowances.description: Kinderfreibetragszähler from ELStAM (affects soli/church tax), default 0

factor.description: factor for tax class IV with factor

tools.name: de_address
tools.description: German address / postcode normalisation and validation: parses a free-text address or postalCode/city/street, checks that the postcode exists, that city and postcode match and that the street exists in that postcode area (fuzzy matching, e.g. 'Hauptstrasse' vs 'Hauptstraße'), and returns the normalised address, state and official municipality key (AGS) plus ranked candidates. Data: OpenStreetMap via OpenPLZ (ODbL), ~8,100 postcodes, 1.2 million street entries. House numbers are not verified. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: de_power_green_hours
tools.description: Greenest hours to use electricity in Germany for the next 36 hours: hourly forecast wind + solar generation vs forecast grid load from the Bundesnetzagentur (SMARD, CC BY 4.0), renewable share per hour, the best contiguous window of N hours (e.g. EV charging, heat pump, batch jobs) and the dirtiest hours. Prices are deliberately not included. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

hours.description: length of the window to find (1-12, default 3)

tools.name: us_filings_financials
tools.description: SEC EDGAR XBRL financials for a US-listed company (ticker or CIK): revenue, net income, diluted EPS, operating cash flow, total assets/liabilities and shares for the latest 3 fiscal years and 4 quarters, with year-on-year changes. Q4 is derived as FY minus Q1–Q3 when no explicit quarter is tagged; cash-flow quarters are split out of year-to-date figures when needed. Source: official companyfacts (public domain). 503 and no charge if EDGAR is down. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

ticker.description: SEC ticker, e.g. AAPL or BRK-B (dot or hyphen)

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, 1-10 digits; used instead of or together with ticker

tools.name: us_filings_recent
tools.description: Latest SEC EDGAR filings for a US-listed company (ticker or CIK), with form type, filing and report dates, 8-K item codes and names (e.g. 2.02 Results of Operations), the primary document and an index link. Default forms: 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K (amendments included). 503 and no charge if EDGAR is down. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

forms.description: comma-separated form types (default 8-K,10-Q,10-K); amendments are included unless you ask only for /A

tools.name: eu_filings_esef
tools.description: Key IFRS metrics from the latest ESEF (or UKSEF) annual report for a company identified by LEI: revenue, net income, diluted EPS, operating cash flow, total assets/liabilities and shares outstanding, including comparative years in that report with year-on-year changes. Source: filings.xbrl.org (no restrictions on use, 22.11.2026). Coverage is incomplete (Germany and Ireland are typically missing). 503 and no charge if the index or the xBRL-JSON extract is down. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: eu_tenders_search
tools.description: Search current EU public-procurement notices (TED / Official Journal S): filter by CPV prefix, ISO country or NUTS region, keywords, estimated-value range (EUR) and a minimum tender deadline (default: still open). Returns title, buyer, CPV, value, deadline, procedure, official link and a short summary of the lot description. Source: official TED Search API; commercial reuse allowed (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU). 503 and no charge if TED is down. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

cpv.description: CPV code or prefix (2-8 digits), comma-separated, e.g. 72 or 72000000,45233100

country.description: ISO 3166 country (DE or DEU) matching buyer or place of performance

nuts.description: NUTS region of the place of performance, e.g. DE1 or DE111

deadlineAfter.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default today (only still-open notices). Pass open=false to include closed ones.

tools.name: eu_tenders_bid_outline
tools.description: Deterministic, LLM-free bid outline from a TED publication number or pasted tender text: extracts eligibility, exclusion and award requirements, scores fit against a company profile by CPV and keyword overlap, and returns a German or English structure (cover letter, Eignung, approach, open questions) with placeholders. 503 and no charge if TED is down and no text was supplied. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

text.description: tender text, used instead of or in addition to id

language.description: de, en, or auto (default auto from the notice language)

profile.description: company profile: name, cpv, keywords, country, nuts, certifications, employees, description, references, headquarters

tools.name: eu_tenders_bid_draft
tools.description: German or English bid draft (cover letter, Eignung, approach, open questions) plus the same deterministic fit score as bid-outline. Uses a cheap OpenRouter model with a token and daily cost cap; invented facts are avoided and gaps stay as placeholders. 503 and no charge if TED (when no text is given) or the model is down, or if the daily cost cap is reached. Price: $0.05 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: de_energy_14a_module
tools.description: German § 14a EnWG grid-fee reduction for heat pumps and wallboxes: compares Modul 1 (flat amount per meter point, BNetzA formula 80 EUR + grid energy price x 3,750 kWh x 20 %, or the grid operator's published value) with Modul 2 (grid-fee energy price cut by 60 % on a separate meter, minus extra meter costs), returns yearly savings incl. VAT, the break-even consumption and the better module. Modul 3 noted, not modelled. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

kwh.description: yearly consumption of the heat pump / wallbox in kWh

gridEnergyPriceCt.description: grid-fee energy price (Netzentgelt-Arbeitspreis) net in ct/kWh, default 8

flatNet.description: Modul 1 flat amount net EUR/year from the grid operator; default BNetzA formula

secondMeterCostYear.description: extra yearly cost of the second meter in EUR incl. VAT, default 60

oneOffCost.description: one-off installation cost in EUR, spread over years

tools.name: fin_used_price_estimate
tools.description: Indicative private-sale price in EUR from a product name or EAN, optional new price, age in months, condition (new, like_new, good, fair, defective) and category (smartphone, laptop, camera, furniture, and others). Fixed depreciation curves and condition multipliers; no marketplace scraping. If newPrice is omitted, a cost-capped model may estimate EU retail (flagged). 503 and no charge if that estimate is required and the model fails. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

newPrice.description: current new / list price in EUR; estimated via a cheap model if omitted

condition.description: new | like_new | good | fair | defective (default good)

tools.name: de_energy_day_ahead
tools.description: German/Luxembourg (DE-LU) day-ahead electricity spot price (Börsenstrompreis) for today, tomorrow (after the ~12:00 CET auction) or any date since 2018: hourly or 15-minute prices in EUR/MWh and ct/kWh, daily avg/min/max, negative-price hours, and the cheapest and most expensive N-hour window for EV charging, heat pumps or batteries, plus an optional all-in dynamic-tariff estimate. Source: Bundesnetzagentur | SMARD.de, CC BY 4.0. 404 and no charge if not yet published. Price: $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

window.description: length of the cheapest / most expensive block in hours, 0.25-12, default 3

fixedCtGross.description: optional gross ct/kWh added to spot x VAT for an all-in dynamic-tariff estimate (grid fees, levies, tax, margin), e.g. 20

tools.name: eu_rates
tools.description: Euro interest-rate snapshot in one call: €STR (euro short-term rate) with day change and spread to the deposit facility, ECB key policy rates (deposit facility, main refinancing, marginal lending) with the date and size of the last change, and the euro-area government bond spot yield curve (AAA-rated or all issuers; 3M to 30Y) with 1-day and 1-week changes in bp, 2s10s / 3m10y / 5s30s spreads and curve shape (normal/flat/inverted). Latest or any date since 2019-10-01. Source: European Central Bank Data Portal, reused with attribution. Informational, not investment advice. 503 and no charge if the ECB is down. Price: $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

curve.description: aaa (default, AAA-rated euro-area central government bonds) or all (all euro-area central government bonds)

date.description: optional YYYY-MM-DD (>= 2019-10-01); values as of that date or the latest earlier publication

tools.name: eu_energy_green_window
tools.description: Electricity traffic light (Stromampel) and renewable-share-of-load forecast for Germany, Austria, Switzerland, France, Netherlands, Belgium, Poland, Denmark, Spain, Italy or Czechia: current hour, upcoming hourly forecast (until end of the available horizon, usually today and partly tomorrow), green/yellow/red hour counts, and the greenest and dirtiest upcoming N-hour window for EV charging, heat pumps, batteries or batch compute jobs. For Germany it also returns a green-and-cheap window weighed against the DE-LU day-ahead price. Shares can exceed 100% when renewables exceed load. Source: Energy-Charts.info (Fraunhofer ISE), CC BY 4.0. 503 and no charge if upstream is down. Price: $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

country.description: de (default), at, ch, fr, nl, be, pl, dk, es, it, cz

withPrice.description: Germany only: add day-ahead prices and greenAndCheapWindow (default true)

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Current weather and short hourly (up to 48h) + daily (up to 7d) forecast worldwide by city name or lat/lon: temperature (°C), humidity, wind speed/direction, pressure, cloud cover, precipitation and condition code. Source: MET Norway Locationforecast 2.0 (CC BY 4.0) + OpenStreetMap/Photon geocoding (ODbL). 404/503 and no charge if location not found or upstream is down. Price: $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

city.description: city or place name (alternative to lat & lon), e.g. Berlin

country.description: optional 2-letter ISO country code filter for city search, e.g. DE, US

tools.name: web_url_safety
tools.description: Pre-fetch URL phishing, scam and risk check without visiting the target: returns verdict (safe, suspicious, malicious), riskScore (0-100) and detailed reasons across MetaMask eth-phishing-detect + Phishing.Database blocklists, punycode/homoglyph mixed-script detection, IP hosts, userinfo traps, suspicious TLDs, brand impersonation and RDAP domain age. Price: $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

url.description: URL or domain to inspect (e.g. https://example.com/login)

tools.name: crypto_funding_rates
tools.description: Perpetual-futures funding rates from Hyperliquid and dYdX v4 public APIs: hourly and annualized (×24×365) rate, next funding time, mark/oracle price and open interest per venue, plus the simple cross-venue difference (Hyperliquid minus dYdX). Optional symbol(s) (default BTC,ETH,SOL) and historyHours. Informational only, not investment advice. 404/503 and no charge if symbols are missing or all upstreams are down. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

symbols.description: comma-separated base symbols, e.g. BTC,ETH,SOL (also BTC-USD). Default BTC,ETH,SOL; 'all' for up to 40 overlapping markets

symbol.description: alias of symbols for a single market

historyHours.description: optional 1-168 hours of hourly history; at most 8 symbols

tools.name: ai_prompt_injection
tools.description: Heuristic prompt-injection and jailbreak classifier (no LLM): verdict safe/suspicious/malicious, riskScore 0–100, matched categories (instruction override, role/system impersonation, data exfiltration, tool/command invocation, jailbreak patterns, hidden/encoded content) and snippets. English, German, Spanish and French patterns. POST {text} or GET ?text= for short inputs, max 20 000 characters. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

text.description: Input to classify, max 20000 characters. Aliases: prompt, content, input. GET also accepts ?text=.

tools.name: web_ui_check
tools.description: Headless Chromium UI/layout & WCAG contrast check at desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844): horizontal overflow, overlapping/clipped text, axe-core contrast failures, broken images, 4xx/5xx resources, console/request errors, viewport meta, mobile tap-target size, LCP/CLS timing and optional small JPEG thumbnails. SSRF-protected, 25s cap. GET ?url= or POST {url}. Price: $0.02 USDC per call via x402.

url.description: Public http/https URL to render and inspect

screenshots.description: Optional: include small desktop/mobile JPEG thumbnails (default false)
